complete_anything_lidar.verified: CAL infers completed objects from a single LiDAR scan at inference. Its training-label engine uses SAM2 video masks, calibrated camera/LiDAR sequences, temporal aggregation and CLIP features.
complete_anything_lidar.project_assessment: Useful design for collecting partial turtle observations and tracking instances. An OAK stereo point cloud is a different sensor/domain; turtle completion and detector benefits are unproven. Inferred occupancy cannot replace measured depth or establish absence of turtles.
complete_anything_lidar.availability: No released code/checkpoint link found on the reviewed official project page; not installed or downloaded.
complete_anything_lidar.recommended_scope: Future research branch: segmented multi-view object reconstruction, with observed/inferred masks and real validation. Current detector keeps measured depth validity unchanged.

rgb_depth_or_experiment.status: Implemented and tested in user-authorized 2026-10-26 pilot; see output/dual-detector-20261026/summary.json
rgb_depth_or_experiment.benefit: Union can recover unique misses at fixed branch thresholds
rgb_depth_or_experiment.cost: Union also passes false alarms from either branch; error independence cannot be assumed
rgb_depth_or_experiment.requirements: Train a separate depth/validity model on reviewed real pairs and backgrounds; calibrate branch thresholds, retain unavailable-depth status and box/branch provenance
rgb_depth_or_experiment.comparison: RGB only, depth only, OR, current feature fusion; same encounter-held-out data; compare recall at matched false alerts per minute plus latency
rgb_depth_or_experiment.result: Geometry-only detector trained on 192 simulated scenes for 10 epochs. OR added zero alert frames over RGB on 159 unreviewed OAK frames; real benefit not established.

rt_detr.verified: TAO supports training, evaluation, inference, export and distillation with COCO JSON labels. Example uses feature strides 8,16,32 and a ResNet-50 backbone; other backbones are configurable.
rt_detr.assessment: Reasonable RGB challenger, not a ready depth detector. COCO comparisons against older YOLO models do not establish superiority over this project's YOLO26-P2; original paper notes small-object limitations. Validate on independent turtle encounters and intended hardware.
rt_detr.status: Official Ultralytics RT-DETR-L weights downloaded and fine-tuned locally for 10 epochs; NVIDIA TAO runtime was not run.
rt_detr.pilot_result: Common existing validation AP50-95 0.6722 vs YOLO26-P2 0.5512; both 44/51 TP with 9 vs 22 FP at selected thresholds. Different training budgets and no independent field test.

ngc_transfusion.verified: Despite the catalog name Transfusion, its v1.0 model card describes BEVFusion and a people detector trained on synthetic indoor camera/LiDAR data. Inputs include RGB, XYZ plus LiDAR intensity, and calibration; output is 3D boxes.
ngc_transfusion.project_assessment: Not a turtle model or splat reconstructor. Adapting it needs turtle 3D annotations, sensor/domain adaptation and evaluation. OAK raw stereo confidence is not LiDAR intensity. BEV/voxel fusion is a separate research architecture from the project's current image-plane RGB-depth detector.
ngc_transfusion.availability: Catalog model available under its stated EULA; not downloaded or run.
ngc_transfusion.recommended_scope: Defer until simpler fused detector has real labeled RGB-depth data and measured results.
